thirdPartyPlugins.title: Plugins
thirdPartyPlugins.introWhatBody: ZeroLaunch can be extended with plugins that run alongside the host. Plugins come from two sources: built-in plugins ship with the app (e.g. Calculator, Translator); third-party plugins are developed separately — install them from the Plugin Market or drop a .zip package onto this page. By UI form, plugins come in two kinds: inline and standalone.
thirdPartyPlugins.introInlineBody: A lightweight plugin that lives with the search bar. Type "trigger keyword + space + content" (e.g. fy hello for Translator) and it activates automatically — no manual selection — with results/panels shown below the search bar. Best for instant, single-purpose tasks.
thirdPartyPlugins.introPanelBody: A plugin with full control over the UI. You wake it manually first: pick it from the candidate list, or press its declared global hotkey (e.g. the Everything file-search plugin). Once open, it takes over the whole search window and customizes the interface and interaction entirely.
thirdPartyPlugins.diffWakePanel: Pick the candidate or press the plugin's global hotkey
thirdPartyPlugins.diffUiInline: Panel embedded in the search window, search bar kept
thirdPartyPlugins.diffUiPanel: Takes over the whole search window, UI customized by the plugin
thirdPartyPlugins.diffUseInline: Lightweight instant single tasks (e.g. Calculator, Translator)
thirdPartyPlugins.diffUsePanel: Complex UI and heavy workflows (e.g. Everything file search)
thirdPartyPlugins.introSeeDetail: A plugin's form is shown in its Details on this page.
thirdPartyPlugins.modeInlineHint: Activates from a trigger keyword; the panel stays inside the search window (search bar kept).
thirdPartyPlugins.modePanelHint: Opened via candidate selection or a global hotkey; takes over the whole search window.
thirdPartyPlugins.dropHint: Drop a .zip plugin package or plugin directory here
thirdPartyPlugins.installRiskContent: Third-party plugins run with the same privileges as this app, and their UI executes inside the host window (styles are isolated only). Only install plugins from sources you trust.

appearance-config.name: Appearance
appearance-config.description: Customize the theme, colors, background image and the sizes and fonts of each part of the search window (the UI language is under General)

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Choose light, dark or follow system theme

search_bar_height.label: Search bar height
search_bar_height.note: The search bar font size is this height × the ratio

search_bar_font_ratio.label: Search bar font ratio
search_bar_font_ratio.desc: Font size = search bar height × this ratio

search_bar_font_family.label: Search bar font
search_bar_font_family.desc: Select from installed system fonts; empty follows system
search_bar_font_family.note: Click "List system fonts" to the right of the field first, then pick one

search_bar_placeholder.label: Search bar placeholder
search_bar_placeholder.desc: The grey hint text shown while the search bar is empty
search_bar_placeholder.note: Only shown for normal search; entering parameter mode replaces it with a fixed parameter hint

search_bar_placeholder_align.label: Placeholder alignment
search_bar_placeholder_align.desc: Alignment of the placeholder text (Auto: centered when it fits, left aligned when it does not fit)
search_bar_placeholder_align.note: When it does not fit, the overflow is clipped with no ellipsis

search_bar_input_follow_align.label: Input text follows alignment
search_bar_input_follow_align.desc: When enabled the typed query uses the same alignment as the placeholder (Auto is treated as center); when disabled it stays left aligned

result_item_height.label: Result item height
result_item_height.note: The title, subtitle and icon sizes are all this height × their ratios

result_item_font_ratio.label: Title font ratio
result_item_font_ratio.desc: Title font size = result item height × this ratio
result_item_font_ratio.note: This font size is also used for candidate names in the parameter panel and section headings on the settings page

result_item_subtitle_font_ratio.label: Subtitle font ratio
result_item_subtitle_font_ratio.desc: Subtitle font size = result item height × this ratio
result_item_subtitle_font_ratio.note: The trigger keyword chips in the search bar use this size too

result_item_icon_ratio.label: Icon size ratio
result_item_icon_ratio.desc: Icon size = result item height × this ratio
result_item_icon_ratio.note: Changes do not apply to already shown results; search again to see them

result_item_font_family.label: Result list font
result_item_font_family.desc: Select from installed system fonts; empty follows system
result_item_font_family.note: Click "List system fonts" to the right of the field first, then pick one

show_subtitle.label: Show subtitle
show_subtitle.desc: Show the subtitle in result items (program path, URL or the raw command)
show_subtitle.note: Once off, long paths no longer show a hover tooltip with the full value; search again for the change to take effect

footer_height.label: Footer height
footer_height.note: Even when very small, the footer row still keeps a bit of height and the settings button; the footer height is also the base for global small text, so setting it to 0 makes the small text in the context menu, parameter panel, plugin panel and settings page invisible

footer_font_ratio.label: Footer font ratio
footer_font_ratio.desc: Global small-text ratio (small text = footer height × this ratio)
footer_font_ratio.note: The context menu, result action buttons, parameter panel hints, plugin panel and settings page descriptions all use this size

footer_font_family.label: Footer font
footer_font_family.desc: Select from installed system fonts; empty follows system
footer_font_family.note: Click "List system fonts" to the right of the field first, then pick one

window_width.label: Window width
window_width.note: In logical pixels, scaled by the system DPI; a window wider than the screen overflows both sides

vertical_position_ratio.label: Vertical position ratio
vertical_position_ratio.desc: Vertical ratio of the window's top edge on the screen (0 hugs the top, 1 falls off the screen)
vertical_position_ratio.note: Has no effect when window dragging is on and a position has already been remembered

hover_color.label: Hover
hover_color.desc: Background of the selected item and mouse hover in the result list

dark_bg_primary.label: Primary background
dark_bg_primary.desc: Primary background color in dark mode

dark_bg_secondary.label: Secondary background
dark_bg_secondary.desc: Secondary background color in dark mode

dark_text_primary.label: Primary text
dark_text_primary.desc: Primary text color in dark mode

dark_text_secondary.label: Secondary text
dark_text_secondary.desc: Secondary text color in dark mode

dark_accent_color.label: Accent
dark_accent_color.note: Use #RRGGBB or rgb()/rgba(); a color name (e.g. red) makes the selection and highlight backgrounds fall back to the default blue

dark_hover_color.label: Hover
dark_hover_color.desc: Background of the selected item and mouse hover in dark mode

bg_image.label: Background image
bg_image.desc: Background image of the search window; a locally picked image is copied into app data, empty disables it
bg_image.note: Deleting the original file has no effect; supports png/jpg/jpeg/webp/ico, up to 20MB each

bg_image_dark.label: Dark background image
bg_image_dark.desc: Background image in dark mode; empty falls back to the light one

bg_size.label: Background size
bg_size.desc: How the background image is scaled
bg_size.note: Cover crops the edges, contain may leave blank space; has no effect without a background image

bg_position.label: Background position
bg_position.desc: Where the background image is anchored in the window
bg_position.note: Decides which part of the image is shown when it does not fill the window; has no effect without a background image

bg_repeat.label: Background repeat

bg_repeat.note: Whether to keep tiling when the image is smaller than the window; has no effect without a background image

bg_opacity.label: Background opacity
bg_opacity.desc: Background image opacity (0 fully transparent ~ 1 opaque)

list_fonts.label: List system fonts
list_fonts.description: Scan fonts installed on this computer

auto_refresh_interval_mins.desc: Refresh the search index at a fixed interval; 0 disables scheduled refresh
auto_refresh_interval_mins.note: The timer restarts after the install monitor fires or a manual refresh

bias-config.name: Fixed Offset
bias-config.description: Set fixed weight offsets for programs to adjust their position in search results

entries.label: Fixed offsets

entries.note: Use the search picker inside an entry to choose a program; only affects ranking, not names or icons

target.label: Program
target.desc: Target program, filled in by the search picker

bias.label: Offset
bias.desc: Positive boosts ranking, negative lowers it

exclusion-config.name: Result Exclusion
exclusion-config.description: Exclude search results uniformly by exact target, directory or keyword, covering all data sources and plugin candidates

rules.label: Exclusion rules
rules.desc: Matching candidates never appear in search results; hides from the context menu and manually added rules share this list
rules.note: Exact excludes only that item, Directory also covers subdirectories, and Contains matches text in the target or the name

kind.label: Match mode
kind.desc: Exact = this target only; Directory = the directory and its subdirectories; Contains = target or name contains the keyword

target.desc: Rule value: the picked target for Exact and Directory, any text for Contains

candidate-registry.description: Provides indexed program data to the "Search programs" entry in settings and has no configurable fields itself

search_candidates.label: Search programs
search_candidates.description: Search indexed programs by name or path

general-config.name: General
general-config.description: General app behavior, including debug mode

language.label: UI Language
language.note: The UI, tray menu and settings window title change immediately, no restart needed

is_auto_start.label: Start on boot
is_auto_start.desc: Start ZeroLaunch automatically when the current user logs in
is_auto_start.note: Implemented as a scheduled task (lowest privileges); the task records the current program path, so after moving the program folder, toggle it off and on once to point at the new location

is_debug_mode.label: Debug mode
is_debug_mode.desc: When enabled, a Debug page appears in settings for durations and score details
is_debug_mode.note: The Debug page also shows keyword generation results and AI assistant traces; turning it off removes all these entries and does not affect normal search

log_level.label: Log level
log_level.desc: Controls the verbosity of log output
log_level.note: Applies immediately, no restart needed; only affects this app's own log file, not third-party plugin processes

reset_session_on_wake.label: Reset session on wake
reset_session_on_wake.desc: When enabled, each launcher show restores the initial search UI (parameter panel and inline parameter mode always reset). When disabled, plugin panel state persists across hide/show.

is_show_tray_icon.label: Show tray icon
is_show_tray_icon.desc: When enabled, show the ZeroLaunch icon in the system tray. When disabled, the icon is hidden (settings can still be opened from the search bar's right-click menu).

enable_cli_server.label: Local CLI service
enable_cli_server.desc: Let the zl command-line tool query search sessions, plugins and settings over a read-only HTTP interface on 127.0.0.1 (random port only)
enable_cli_server.note: Read-only interface; the connection token is written to cli-token.json in the data directory. Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.

model-openai-config.name: OpenAI-compatible models
model-openai-config.description: Connect to cloud model services via an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI / DeepSeek, etc.)

base_url.label: API base URL
base_url.note: Include the version segment; a wrong value does not fail on save, only when fetching models or chatting

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.note: When empty no credentials are sent, so only local compatible services that need no auth work

models.label: Model list
models.desc: Declare the available models and set each one's call parameters
models.note: Empty means no models are provided; click "Fetch model list" to pull models from the server

test_connection.label: Test connection
test_connection.description: Request the model list once with the base URL and key currently entered to verify the credentials

fetch_models.label: Fetch model list
fetch_models.description: Fetch available models from the server and merge them into the list (the OpenAI protocol does not return model parameters; set them manually)

model-ollama-config.name: Ollama models
model-ollama-config.description: Run models through a local Ollama server

base_url.label: Server URL
base_url.note: Must include the http:// prefix; a wrong address makes it unusable

models.label: Model list
models.desc: Declare available models and set per-model call parameters; empty lists all local models as chat models; use "Fetch model list" to pull local models

fetch_models.label: Fetch model list
fetch_models.description: Fetch model metadata from the local Ollama server and merge it into the list

name.label: Model ID
name.desc: Model name as recognized by the provider, e.g. gpt-4o-mini / qwen3:8b
name.note: Entries with an empty or wrong name are ignored; Ollama only lists models already present locally

kind.label: Role
kind.note: A wrong choice puts the model in the other list (semantic search only recognizes embedding entries); fetching the model list guesses from the name or capabilities, and you can change it back manually

max_tokens.label: Max output tokens
max_tokens.desc: Generation limit per response; defaults to 2048

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.desc: Reasoning level; a level other than None requires the Reasoning capability to be checked

context_length.label: Model maximum context length
context_length.desc: The maximum input context length the model accepts (read-only)
context_length.note: Filled in by "Fetch model list" from Ollama metadata, and Ollama chats set the context window from it; OpenAI-compatible endpoints do not return this metadata, so it stays 0

dimensions.label: Output dimensions
dimensions.note: Ollama entries get overwritten by model metadata when the model list is fetched; OpenAI-compatible entries cannot get that metadata, so a value has no effect

similarity.label: Similarity metric
similarity.desc: How embedding vector similarity is computed
similarity.note: Used by semantic-search plugins to compare vectors and must match the model's training; a wrong choice distorts the similarity values

chat_capabilities.label: Chat capabilities
chat_capabilities.desc: Declare the request capabilities this model supports
chat_capabilities.note: Tool calling and reasoning are enabled by default; uncheck any capability your model doesn't support, or the matching requests fail

embedding_capabilities.label: Embedding capabilities
embedding_capabilities.desc: Declare the embedding capabilities this model supports
embedding_capabilities.note: Only Output dimension truncation exists so far; semantic search that sends an output dimension fails outright when it is not checked

help-agent-config.name: AI Assistant
help-agent-config.description: Ask about settings in natural language: the assistant answers from the settings manual plus your current configuration, and never changes anything

model_id.label: Assistant model
model_id.desc: Pick one of the configured chat models; empty keeps the assistant off
model_id.note: The model must support tool calling; it's enabled by default, so switch models if yours doesn't support it

list_chat_models.label: Refresh model list
list_chat_models.description: Re-read the selectable chat models from the host model list

hotkey-config.name: Hotkey Config
hotkey-config.description: Set global hotkeys to quickly wake the search window

open_search_bar.label: Open search bar
open_search_bar.desc: Click then press a key combination to record it; leave empty to set no global hotkey
open_search_bar.note: Prefer combinations with Ctrl/Alt; a single key (e.g. A or Space) steals everyday typing, and combinations taken by other apps may fail to register

double_click_ctrl.label: Double-click Ctrl to open
double_click_ctrl.desc: When enabled, quickly double-pressing Ctrl opens the search bar
double_click_ctrl.note: Coexists with the "Open search bar" hotkey, neither affects the other

entries.label: Icon overrides
entries.desc: First find the program in the search box above and click edit, then pick a new icon file in the dialog
entries.note: Supports .exe/.lnk/.png/.ico; the choice is written to the icon cache immediately and the file path is not stored

target_type.label: Target type
target_type.desc: Target type, determined automatically by the icon override flow

icon_request_json.label: Icon request
icon_request_json.desc: The raw icon request, written automatically by the icon override flow

custom_icon_path.label: Icon file
custom_icon_path.desc: Choose a new icon file (.exe, .lnk, .png, .ico, etc.)

apply_override.label: Apply icon
apply_override.description: Immediately process the chosen icon file into the cache without saving the path

installation-monitor-config.name: Installation Monitor
installation-monitor-config.description: Monitor software installs and auto-update the search index

enable_installation_monitor.label: Enable install monitor
enable_installation_monitor.desc: When enabled, watch filesystem changes (e.g. Start Menu) to detect program installs and uninstalls
enable_installation_monitor.note: On by default; the toggle takes effect immediately, no restart needed

monitor_debounce_secs.label: Debounce wait (seconds)
monitor_debounce_secs.desc: Rescan the index only after changes stop and stay quiet for this long
monitor_debounce_secs.note: Any further change restarts the timer; only effective when the install monitor is enabled

monitor_watch_paths.label: Watch paths
monitor_watch_paths.desc: Directories to watch, one per line; empty uses the system Start Menu
monitor_watch_paths.note: When empty, the common and current-user Start Menus are used; missing paths are skipped; only effective when the install monitor is enabled

window-behavior-config.name: Window Behavior
window-behavior-config.description: Customize search window open, hide and focus behavior

is_esc_hide_window_priority.label: ESC hides window first
is_esc_hide_window_priority.desc: When enabled, pressing ESC hides the window directly instead of clearing input first
is_esc_hide_window_priority.note: Only applies to the search list; ESC in inline parameters and the parameter panel still exits that panel

space_is_enter.label: Space acts as Enter
space_is_enter.desc: When enabled, Space launches the selected item directly (only effective in the search list)
space_is_enter.note: The trade-off is that you cannot type spaces in the search box, so multi-word search and entering parameter mode with "trigger + space" both stop working

is_wake_on_fullscreen.label: Allow popup in fullscreen
is_wake_on_fullscreen.desc: When enabled, the search bar can still pop up over a fullscreen foreground app

launch_new_on_failure.label: Launch new instance on activation failure
launch_new_on_failure.desc: When enabled, launch a new program instance if the wake attempt fails (shared by Enter and Shift+Enter)

wake_existing_first.label: Enter behaves like Shift+Enter
wake_existing_first.desc: When enabled, Enter wakes the running instance first and falls back exactly like Shift+Enter. When disabled, Enter launches a new instance directly

is_show_home_on_empty_query.label: Show frequent items on empty query
is_show_home_on_empty_query.desc: When enabled, an empty search box (window wake or cleared input) shows frequently used candidates ranked by launch history; Enter or click launches directly

is_enable_drag_window.label: Enable window dragging
is_enable_drag_window.desc: When enabled, the search bar window can be dragged and its position remembered for next wake

show_pos_follow_mouse.label: Follow mouse display
show_pos_follow_mouse.desc: When enabled, the search bar appears on the display under the mouse on wake (multi-display). Lower priority than window dragging.
show_pos_follow_mouse.note: When window dragging is on but no position has been dragged yet, the window returns to the center of the primary display

window_position_x.label: Window position X
window_position_x.desc: Horizontal window position remembered from dragging (read-only, written by dragging)
window_position_x.note: Only used as the window position when "Enable window dragging" is on

window_position_y.label: Window position Y
window_position_y.desc: Vertical window position remembered from dragging (read-only, written by dragging)
window_position_y.note: Only used as the window position when "Enable window dragging" is on

move_up_key.label: Move selection up key
move_up_key.desc: Moves the selection up (default Ctrl+K, works in search and param panels); clear to keep arrow keys only

move_down_key.label: Move selection down key
move_down_key.desc: Moves the selection down (default Ctrl+J, works in search and param panels); clear to keep arrow keys only

sources.label: Bookmark sources
sources.desc: Browser bookmark sources to index; click "Auto-detect browsers" to scan and add them
sources.note: Every detected entry is off by default and must be checked to enable

name.label: Browser name
name.desc: Browser and profile name (filled by auto-detect, cannot be edited)

bookmarks_path.label: Bookmark file path
bookmarks_path.desc: Bookmark file path (filled by auto-detect, cannot be edited)
bookmarks_path.note: Only Bookmarks JSON files such as Chrome/Edge are supported; Firefox's places.sqlite is not

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether this bookmark source is enabled

overrides.label: Override configs
overrides.desc: Exclusions and custom titles for individual bookmarks
overrides.note: Select a source in the bookmark source list, click "Read bookmarks", then check or edit bookmarks one by one in the list

url.label: URL
url.desc: Bookmark URL to match (whole-string exact match, ignoring case and trailing slashes)
url.note: Filled in automatically by "Read bookmarks"; a fragment alone will not match

custom_title.label: Custom title
custom_title.desc: Custom title replacing the original; empty keeps the original

detectBrowsers.label: Auto-detect browsers
detectBrowsers.desc: Scans installed browsers for bookmark file paths

readBookmarks.label: Read bookmarks
readBookmarks.desc: Reads every bookmark from the given browser bookmark file

commands.label: Custom commands
commands.note: Both name and command are required, and an entry with either empty is skipped; the name is also the result text and the default trigger keyword

command.label: Command
command.note: Can be a program path plus arguments, or shell syntax like cd and &&; curly-brace placeholders in the command receive the arguments (clip, hwnd and selection are built-in placeholders too), and values are split on spaces when substituted, so quote paths that contain spaces yourself; it runs silently in the background with no visible output, and the working directory is where the app started

triggerKeywords.label: Trigger keywords
triggerKeywords.desc: Comma-separated trigger keywords; type a trigger plus a space to enter parameter mode
triggerKeywords.note: Do not separate with spaces; empty defaults to the name as the trigger

directories.label: Scan directories
directories.note: A few entries for the Start Menu and Desktop are preset; saving the changes triggers a rescan immediately, no restart needed

root_path.label: Directory path
root_path.note: An empty value makes this rule scan nothing

max_depth.label: Scan depth
max_depth.note: 1 means only files in the root directory; larger numbers scan deeper

pattern.label: File patterns
pattern.note: Matched against the file name only, not its directory

pattern_type.label: Match mode
pattern_type.desc: File pattern syntax: wildcard or regular expression
pattern_type.note: Both syntaxes apply to the file name only

excluded_keywords.label: Excluded keywords
excluded_keywords.desc: Skip file names containing these keywords
excluded_keywords.note: Only the file name is compared, not its directory; use "Forbidden paths" to skip whole directories

forbidden_paths.label: Forbidden paths
forbidden_paths.desc: These directories and their subdirectories are not scanned
forbidden_paths.note: Enter full paths; non-existent paths never match

symlink_mode.label: Symlink mode
symlink_mode.note: .symlink-suffix-only mode does not follow real symlinks; auto mode includes real symlinks as well

url-source.name: Web Page Source
url-source.description: Open preset web pages with keywords

web_pages.label: Indexed web pages
web_pages.note: Both name and URL are required, and an entry with either empty is skipped; the name is also the search basis and the default trigger

name.label: Name
name.desc: Display name of the web page

url.label: URL
url.desc: Full URL; must include http:// or https://
url.note: Without a protocol it is treated as a local file and will not open; curly-brace placeholders in the URL receive the arguments, and the built-in clip, hwnd and selection placeholders are supported too

triggerKeywords.label: Trigger keywords
triggerKeywords.desc: Comma-separated trigger keywords; type a trigger plus a space to enter parameter mode
triggerKeywords.note: Do not separate with spaces; empty defaults to the name as the trigger

alias-optimizer.name: Alias
alias-optimizer.description: Add a few alias keywords to specific programs so typing an alias finds them

entries.label: Alias config
entries.note: Pick the target program with the search box first, then type aliases one by one (Enter to confirm); aliases take part in fuzzy matching and ranking just like the program name

target.label: Program
target.desc: Target program (picked with the search box, no manual editing)

aliases.label: Aliases
aliases.desc: Aliases for this program; add several, pressing Enter to confirm each
aliases.note: Matched with the same fuzzy matching as the program name; very short aliases tend to drag in other programs

first-letter-extractor.name: First-letter Extractor
first-letter-extractor.description: Extract the first letter of each keyword segment as an abbreviation to support fuzzy matching like qyl

priority.label: Priority
priority.desc: Optimizer execution priority; smaller runs first
priority.note: Equal values leave the order undetermined, so give different values to fix the order; when consuming another optimizer's output, the referenced one must have a smaller value or this one gets no input

input_source.label: Input source
input_source.desc: Which keyword layer to draw words from
input_source.note: Original name = the program name with its original casing, processed once; Normalized lowercase base = the name after removing version numbers and collapsing runs of spaces into one, lowercased; Refined keyword pool = every keyword generated so far, processed one by one; Another optimizer's output = the keywords produced by the optimizer set as Producer. A wrong layer makes this optimizer produce no keywords

producer_id.label: Producer
producer_id.desc: component_id of the producer optimizer, e.g. pinyin-converter
producer_id.note: Only needed when the input source is "Another optimizer's output", and its value must be smaller (runs earlier); empty falls back to the refined keyword pool, and a non-existent id leaves this optimizer with no input and no keywords produced

pinyin-converter.description: Convert Chinese characters in keywords to toneless pinyin for pinyin search

history-booster.name: History Booster
history-booster.description: Boost frequently-used candidates by historical selection frequency

history_weight.label: History weight
history_weight.desc: Weight of the total historical launch count; larger means stronger influence

recent_habit_weight.label: Recent habit weight
recent_habit_weight.desc: Weight of launch habits in the last 7 days; larger means stronger influence

temporal_weight.label: Short-term heat weight
temporal_weight.desc: Weight of short-term heat; larger means stronger influence
temporal_weight.note: Based only on how long since the last launch, so never-launched items have no such term; 0 turns it off

temporal_decay.label: Heat decay constant (s)
temporal_decay.desc: Decay time constant of short-term heat; larger decays more slowly

query-affinity-booster.name: Query Affinity Booster
query-affinity-booster.description: Remembers which query launched which program before, and boosts a program when the current input equals that query or is a prefix of it

query_affinity_weight.label: Query affinity weight
query_affinity_weight.desc: Weight of query affinity; larger means stronger influence
query_affinity_weight.note: Only programs previously launched with the same query have this score; 0 turns it off

query_affinity_time_decay.label: Affinity decay constant (s)
query_affinity_time_decay.desc: Time decay constant of affinity; larger decays more slowly

query_affinity_cooldown.label: Affinity cooldown (s)
query_affinity_cooldown.desc: For a given program and query pair, repeat launches within this window are not counted again

bm25_k1.label: Term frequency saturation k1
bm25_k1.desc: Higher values saturate term frequency later; classic value is 1.2

bm25_b.label: Length normalization b
bm25_b.desc: 0 disables length normalization, higher values penalize long keywords more; default 0.3 (below the classic 0.75 because keywords are short and length is already penalized twice)

translator.name: Translate
translator.description: Translate in the search bar: type fy (or tr, 翻译) then a space and the content

translate_mode.label: Trigger mode
translate_mode.desc: Instant: translate on input; Enter: request only after confirm to save tokens

default_target.label: Default target language
default_target.desc: Target language when no code is given (source auto-detected; falls back to another common language if equal to source)

request_timeout_ms.label: Timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.desc: Timeout for the whole translation request
request_timeout_ms.note: A timeout reports a translation timeout directly and does not retry with another engine

live_debounce_secs.label: Live debounce (s)
live_debounce_secs.desc: Debounce wait after input in instant mode to reduce redundant requests

model_id.label: Translation model
model_id.desc: The chat model used for translation
model_id.note: Choose from the chat models configured in model management; translation is unavailable when empty

listModels.label: Fetch host model list
listModels.desc: Retrieves the models configured in the host through the plugin handle

calculator.name: Calculator
calculator.description: Do math in the search bar: type = then a space and an expression, and Enter copies the result to the clipboard

cmd-run.name: Run in cmd
cmd-run.description: Type > followed by a command line; Enter runs it in a cmd window

close_after_run.label: Close window after run
close_after_run.desc: When on, the window closes as soon as the command finishes; when off it stays open so you can read the output and keep typing

row.subtitleKeepOpen: Runs in cmd; the window stays open
row.subtitleCloseAfterRun: Runs in cmd; the window closes after the run

path-detect.name: Path detection
path-detect.description: Offers open / open-containing-folder actions when the input looks like a local path
path-detect.triggerDescription: Matches automatically when the input looks like a local path — no trigger keyword needed

url-detect.name: URL detection
url-detect.description: Offers a browser-open action when the input looks like a URL
url-detect.triggerDescription: Matches automatically when the input looks like a URL — no trigger keyword needed

bare_domain_enabled.label: Recognize bare domains
bare_domain_enabled.desc: When enabled, inputs like github.com are treated as URLs
bare_domain_enabled.note: File names (e.g. main.rs) and two-segment inputs with rare suffixes are not treated as URLs; inputs with http:// are always recognized

unavailable.title: Plugin panel unavailable
unavailable.desc: The plugin does not provide a panel UI (manifest.toml is missing [ui].panelEntry), so the panel cannot be rendered.
